title: CXRQuant: Finding-Level Stability Auditing of Reduced-Precision Inference for Radiology Impression Generation
description:
CXRQuant is a paired audit that re-executes one trained source checkpoint of a radiology report generator under FP32, FP16, BitsAndBytes INT8 and NF4 and reports lexical similarity, FP32-relative finding stability (false-negative and false-positive flip rates, FNF/FPF), reference-based category agreement and measured efficiency as separate axes.

Release 2.3.0 accompanies the second-round revision of the IJIES article (paper ID 20266214). It contains the training, inference, evaluation and replay code; configurations and seeds; corpus and partition identifiers with a script that rebuilds the corpus from the official OpenI release; the archived predictions, references and metric outputs of six models x four precisions x five training seeds; the decoding-corrected and impression-only-loss reruns; report-level, GEE and mixed-effects statistics; a randomised fresh-process efficiency re-measurement; a LoRA-fine-tuned Mistral-7B audit; and CheXagent-8b audits on IU-XRAY and NIH ChestX-ray14. Every reported number can be re-derived on a CPU in minutes; GPU instructions reproduce the training and generation. Fine-tuned checkpoint weights are not included (hashes are).

FP32 is a model-relative baseline, not clinical ground truth. IU-XRAY/OpenI text remains under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (see DATA_NOTICE.md).
